description: This file defines the WorkoutBrowseFragment class, a UI component for browsing workout items in a grid or list format within an Android TV application. It handles displaying a list of workouts, reacting to user clicks to navigate to workout details, and communicates with a ViewModel to observe data changes.

classes.name: WorkoutBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list or grid of workout items for selection, supporting category filtering and navigation to detailed views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the ViewModel observer, and defines click handling for workout items.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of WorkoutBrowseFragment with a specified workout category.
